plain_description.what: Re-scores, on the merged 20-model board, two rules for deciding which model pairs the board may call as ordered: a fitted uncertainty widener and an agreement gate. It compares wrong calls at a matched number of withheld pairs. No calls.
plain_description.why: An earlier claim that the gate always beats the widener had to be rechecked on the board of record.
plain_description.information: It decides which safety rule to ship for declaring 'A beats B'. Result: the widener (with declines) wins. It makes 0 wrong calls against 2 to 3 for the gate at matched withholding, in 20 of 20 settings. This rests on only five wrong events and is not a significance result. The 'gate dominates' claim was dropped. Later ruled 'history, not evidence'.
